The file in this folder is from the meow-rs project (https://github.com/meow-rs/meow-rs) and is licensed with the MIT license. It is the routing table in the `skips_the_tun_split_default_routes` test in `crates/meow-listener/src/tun/route.rs` at commit c526beb, copied out of the Rust string, and only used as input data for unit tests. The test says it was captured from a live table with the TUN device's `0.0.0.0/1` and `128.0.0.0/1` routes.
